prompts: Create a square 3 BY 2 reference sheet with SIX separate original isometric Brazilian neighborhood props on real TRANSPARENT background, each entirely inside its equal slot with generous gaps, no grid/labels/text. Match approved reference's flat 2D MANGA game art, expressive dark navy outlines, warm cel color blocks, one hard shadow, simplified readable shapes, not 3D or photorealism. Orthographic isometric 2:1, full silhouettes, no ground scenery or external cast shadows. Top row: 1 blue cylindrical rooftop WATER TANK with lid, short plumbing pipe and small sturdy support; 2 CLOTHESLINE between two freestanding navy posts with 4 simple coral/cream/cyan garments; 3 KITE MARKET STALL with cream/coral cloth awning, colorful diamond kites hanging, bamboo frames and a few string spools. Bottom row: 4 freestanding park CANOPY with terracotta/coral cloth and yellow/cyan kite pennants, four poles and open walkable space beneath; 5 a complete small L-SHAPED NAVY METAL MIRANTE GUARD RAIL on pale concrete footing, no view background or steps; 6 CRAFTSMAN WOOD WORKTABLE with paper kite, bamboo sticks and string spool, no chair or person. Same family, no glossy bevel, no tiny clutter, no extra objects outside slots, no copied logos. Keep empty spaces truly transparent, not white checkerboard.

Create a THREE COLUMN horizontal sprite sheet of 3 original Brazilian hillside houses, entirely isolated on TRANSPARENT background with wide gutters and full silhouettes. Same approved bold 2D MANGA environment style as reference: expressive thick navy outlines, large flat cel color masses, one hard shadow, warm cream/coral/yellow, simple grouped terracotta roof tiles, navy doors/shutters, paper kite details and a couple flower pots, no 3D model, no bevel, no gradients, no realistic texture. Every house uses the SAME orthographic isometric 2:1 camera with ground edges at +26.565 and -26.565 degrees, verticals vertical; same 3x3 diamond footprint and same human door scale. No painted ground, no scenery or shadows outside footprint, no labels or text. LEFT: cream plaster house with terracotta pitched gable roof and chunky navy doorway on the left-facing wall, shutter window on right-facing wall; one kite-shaped painted diamond detail. MIDDLE: coral plaster flat concrete-roof home with low parapet, doorway on right-facing wall and small two-pane window on left-facing wall, rooftop pot and short folded cloth. RIGHT: warm yellow weathered chapisco house with flat concrete roof, a different arrangement of navy door on left-facing wall and 2 small shutter windows on right-facing wall, few intentional short ink stucco marks only, potted plant. Roofs FULLY ATTACHED to the walls with closed gable triangles, no floating gaps or open joints. Do not attach steps to base; no pipes, street, characters, extra buildings or wires crossing gutters. Scale consistent across all three. Drawn as charming game buildings, NEVER architecture rendering or toy diorama.

Preserve these exact THREE original manga house designs and camera, but fix the crop: add generous transparent padding around EACH entire house, especially rebuild any clipped terracotta roof tip of the first house and keep all rightmost wall edges visible. Three equally sized columns on a wide transparent sheet, separate houses never touching column boundaries, each entire silhouette with at least 30 pixels margin. Keep expressive thick navy ink, flat cream/coral/yellow cel colors, original kite details, differing door/window arrangements. Do not redesign or add scenery, floor, cast shadows, labels or text. True transparent background.
